_: One table, two readers: Scripts/Read-OrgChart.ps1 (tkTestToolkit -OrgChart, Tests/Test-OrgChart.ps1) and the agent's reader. A case builds a scratch hub: hub.json when hubJson is given, org.json from `org` (an object), `orgText` (the raw file text) or `orgFile` (a file under this folder; no org.json when none is given), and an empty prompt file for each name in `prompts` (the table's `prompts` unless the case has its own) in the agentic folder -- agentic/, or `promptsFolder` -- plus an empty folder for each name in promptFolders. `tree` is the one asked for besides the file's own. `expect.status` is ok, missing or invalid. For ok: `activeTree`, `seatCount` (the seats of the tree shown), `warnings` (exact sentences, in order) and `chart` -- the response, compared as JSON, key order aside (docs/hub/org.md, "The response"); `text` is the CLI's lines for it and only the CLI asserts it. Otherwise `kind` is the contract both halves agree on, and `message` is the sentence the CLI says; a reader in another half may say the same sentence or only the kind (`messageStartsWith` stands in for a message that carries the parser's own words). Ids are compared exactly, character for character.

cases.name: valid
cases.why: A tree shaped like ours: the owner as a person, two VPs, a PM, one lead position with three seats on three Spaces (one vacant), and a builder pool with seats [] and its default-model line; a second tree beside it; activeTree chooses the first.

cases.name: valid-second-tree-active
cases.why: The same document with activeTree naming the second tree: the chart is that tree.

cases.name: valid-tree-by-id
cases.why: The first document read with tree=branch: the other tree's chart, and activeTree still says which one the file uses.

cases.name: one-tree-no-active-tree
cases.why: One tree and no activeTree: that tree is the one in use.

cases.name: unknown-keys-and-notes
cases.why: A key the tool does not read is ignored with a warning at every level; an underscore key is a note and is not said. A position with no title shows its id, a tree with no name its id; a seat with active true or false is carried and never drawn.

warnings: org.json: 'colour' is not a key this tool reads -- ignored.
org.json: 'region' is not a key this tool reads in tree 't' -- ignored.
org.json: 'budget' is not a key this tool reads in position 'root' of tree 't' -- ignored.
org.json: 'badge' is not a key this tool reads in seat 'a' of position 'root' in tree 't' -- ignored.

cases.name: agentic-folder-renamed
cases.why: hub.json renames the agentic folder; a prompt is looked for there.

cases.name: cycle
cases.why: Positions report to each other in a loop, with a root beside them; a tail that leads into the loop is not part of it, and the loop is named from the position where the walk up from the first affected position closes it.

expect.message: Positions in tree 'a' report to each other in a loop: p -> r -> q -> p.

cases.why: A position reports to itself.

cases.name: cycle-and-no-root
cases.why: Every position reports to another: the loop is said first, not the missing root.

expect.message: Positions in tree 'a' report to each other in a loop: x -> y -> x.

cases.name: several-roots
cases.why: Two positions report to nobody.
